selection.name: Hand of Gaben
selection.description: Heals all allied heroes on the map as well as all units under Chen's control. A large heal is applied at first and a slow heal over time is applied for 8 seconds afterwards.
selection.superUpgrade: Super: Reduces cooldown by 40s, increases heal by 280 and grants +6 armor to all units affected.
selection.gabenUpgrade: Gaben: Hard dispels globally. When Hand of Gaben is cast, all summons gain the Martydom ability (unit suicides to cast a 50% value single target Hand of Gaben on low HP heroes).

selection.name: Heavenly Grace
selection.description:
Creates a divine barrier around an ally which grants them increased Strength and Health Regeneration. Always apply effects on self.

DISPEL TYPE: Strong Dispel
selection.differences: When casted on an ally, also applies the effects on self.
selection.superUpgrade: Super: Provides 50% status resistance. Plus 20 health regen bonus, -2s cooldown.

selection.name: Hex
selection.description: Transforms an enemy unit into a harmless creature, disabling their attacks and abilities.
selection.superUpgrade: Super: -3 second cooldown, and applies a Break.

selection.name: Icarus Dive
selection.description: Phoenix dives forward in an arc with a fixed distance in the targeted direction, dealing damage over time and slowing the movement speed of any units it comes into contact with, and then orbiting back to its original position. If Phoenix casts Supernova, the dive ends.
selection.differences: Doesn't cost health to cast, and has increased damage. Also slows attack speed.
selection.superUpgrade: Super: Applies max level Fire Spirits debuff on each unit hit and grants the caster magic immunity during Dive.
selection.gabenUpgrade: Gaben: Drops multiple Meteor Hammer at 0.3s interval during the Dive.

selection.name: Ice Blast
selection.description: Launches a tracer toward any location on the battlefield, which must be triggered again to mark the area to be blasted by a damaging explosion of hail. The further the tracer travels, the larger the explosion will be. Enemies caught in the explosion, or who touch the icy ball of hail as it travels, are Frostbitten, taking damage and prevented from regenerating or healing. If a Frostbitten unit's health drops below a certain percentage, they will instantly shatter.
selection.differences: Debuff is shorter, but damage over time is increased.
selection.superUpgrade: Super: Forms an Ice Vortex at its destination just before Ice Blast deals damage. +4% kill threshold.
selection.gabenUpgrade: Gaben: Grants Second Ice Age: Casts Cold Feet on all enemies in the arena, dealing 90 damage per second and stuns for 3.5 seconds if the enemy doesn't move away from the initial cast point.
